scope: P7: determinism (same fit twice -> identical posteriors) and causal replay (truncation: labels up to T identical to full run)
P8: forecast engine artifact for H=8 (ts, state, dwell, predicted next state, confidence, p_change, abstain)
P9: strategy posture map derived from the states + transition risk + abstention gate

protocol.model: multinomial logistic C=1.0, TRAIN-only StandardScaler, features = A2 + one-hot(state) + dwell + NO_DEFINED rate(8) + H1 context

posture_rules.CONTINUATION_POSTURE: state in {EXPANSION, TREND, BREAKOUT_CONFIRMATION, ACCEPTANCE} and low transition risk

explicit_limits: the posture map is NOT a validated strategy and uses NO returns. Profitability and the frozen cost gate belong to the V3 alpha line.
